summary: BTC_DAILY_ULCER_PASSIVE_CORE_FAMILY_CLOSE. Corrected V2 preflights passed at clean commit f48b2928 after the original V1 package stopped before outcome access on a line-ending hash mismatch. Two create-only executions produced byte-identical SHA-256 86a9bbb4f59679df9c0a503379d79a7200b9d5d138d028228482d5be9d6363ee. Primary Ulcer28 reduced historical Validation drawdown from buy-and-hold's 32.28416349 percent to 27.75714563 percent and returned 312.62451446 percent, but captured only 67.266556 percent of buy-and-hold upside and had Calmar 11.26284808 versus 14.39575015. Design return was 87.50914186 percent versus 129.60544229 percent, drawdown reduction was only 1.45173009pp and Calmar was worse. Annual drawdown and Calmar breadth were only 3/5 and 2/5. Ulcer21 failed Validation upside and Calmar stability; Ulcer35 reduced Validation drawdown further to 26.57202896 percent but its Calmar was only 81.70 percent of buy-and-hold and it was rejection-only. Seven primary and three neighbor gates failed, so the exact Ulcer21/28/35 lagged-median 100/50 passive-core family is permanently closed without tuning, candidate creation or OOS access.
uncertainty: Historical Validation is development evidence rather than clean independent OOS; the closure is for the exact frozen Ulcer21, Ulcer28 and Ulcer35 lagged-252-median 100/50-percent passive-core family and does not prove every downside-path or partial-exposure mechanism lacks value.

Ulcer35 had stronger Design and lower Validation drawdown than the primary, but it was frozen as rejection-only and failed its Calmar stability gate; selecting it now would be outcome-driven substitution.

State-change-only rebalancing intentionally allows market drift away from exactly 50 percent between regime changes; daily weight restoration is a different, untested family and cannot be inferred from this result.
